_meta.spec: RFC-002 §6 — provider.parallel_limit feeds the effective_parallel min(); rpm/tpm feed the rate-limit headroom check.
_meta.notes: Providers are the first path segment of a model id (extract_provider_key in api_gateway/rate_limiter.py). SEED VALUES — reconcile with each provider's real published limits. _DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENCY in rate_limiter.py is 5.
